title: The other side of each holding
question: Is everything the current IPS draft (V52) says about what Laura owns, and about the caplet, true at its source? (Q14, the verify round; lens 6, the other side)
serves: North star 4 (investing knowledge, applied and true) and 1 (a voice a judge can trust); Wharton: Investment Strategy and Client Knowledge, and the case's 'clear and consistent investment strategy across all three'
essence: We checked every claim the IPS makes about what Laura owns against the words of the people on the other side: the fund company's own documents, the US Treasury's rules and the medicine leaflets behind the caplet name.
Nearly everything held, but the 2032 floor is a fund that holds Treasury bonds rather than the bonds themselves, and "about a fifteenth" in shares is only true at today's interest rates.
So the IPS should call the floor "a Treasury fund" and say the shares are "under a tenth" of her money, which leaves everything else as it is and makes it one word shorter.
decided: O1 (3-1): P5 says 'a Treasury fund maturing in late 2032' and 'the interest it should earn' (IBTM's index holds Treasuries maturing from 1 Jan to 15 Dec 2032; the fund ends about 15 Dec). V52 496 -> 495 strict
O2 (4-0): 'That is under a tenth of her money.' replaces 'about a fifteenth' (the fifteenth is true at one yield only; the tenth also fits the WInS book's 8.6%). 0 words

No change (14 lines): XR means extended release; a caplet labelled do not crush (Panadol Osteo, Australia); 'the schedule is gone'; 'redeemed' (iShares' own SEC notice: 'automatically redeem your shares'); 'mature like bonds' (iShares' own heading); 'pays exactly what it promises' (31 CFR 356.30); P6 'she promises'; P9; 'Do not crush.'; the bond trader's caplet is a harmless pun; the scaled-book bridge goes to the Final Report
Slip S-11 KEEP narrowly, no new words: while 'Do not crush.' stays, P6's 'liquid any day, as her flexibility' stays with it
seeds: P6's 'that half moves into Treasuries': WInS lists no Treasury bond maturing Feb 2031 to Feb 2036, so the 2031 move buys a fund; does O1's noun fix apply there too? (Writing Room, before Wed 4 Nov)
The kept shares do two jobs, 'her flexibility' and first payer of the reinvestment gap: how much flexibility is left in the bad case? (Genius Lab, MODEL, Final Report)
The Final Report's bridge to the WInS book: the plan scaled to $300,000, IBTM doing two jobs, the pie chart's 'Long Equities', VT at 8.6%, the floorlet line
